decision_conditions:
1. Transport statement required.

2. Acoustic report required.

3. Site plans show car parking in the front garden, however it does not appear there is any existing vehicle access. If this is not an existing/consented situation the applicants will either need to remove these from the plans or add this to decsription of development and show vehicle access on the drawings.

4.  We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? Front extension to existing garage at rear of site and change of use of garage from Class C3 (Dwellinghouse) to Class E (Retail Shop), along with new sign board to front elevation and associated cycle and bin stores.
description: Front extension to existing garage at rear of site and change of use of garage from Class C3 (Dwellinghouse) to Class E (Retail Shop), along with new sign board to front elevation and associated cycle and bin stores.
